description: This Java class 'MacroScreenViewHandler' handles the initialization and rendering of views in the OFBiz web framework, specifically dealing with macro-based screen rendering with support for themes, compression, and different renderers.

classes.name: MacroScreenViewHandler
classes.description: A handler for rendering screens using macro-based themes in the OFBiz framework, extending AbstractViewHandler, responsible for initialization, context preparation, and rendering with theme and compression support.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the handler with the provided ServletContext.

methods.name: loadRenderers
methods.description: Loads and configures various renderer instances based on the current theme and request context, and attaches them to the rendering context.

methods.name: prepareViewContext
methods.description: Prepares the rendering context stack for a view, populating it with request data.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Performs the rendering of a specified view page, handling compression, renderer setup, and output writing.
